anatomyReview.notes: Right-facing bird-only, two folded wings far side occluded, one small gray head/bill gray cere and two yellow feet; brown back and banded long tail. Full original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; expert/native review pending.

Feeding at wasp nest, two folded wings far side occluded, one lowered head/bill and two feet; soil/fern vignette fades along base/sides, upper edge clear. Full original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; expert/native review pending.

Straight front, one central bill gray cere, two folded wings and yellow feet, gray head/slender neck, pale barred underside and long banded tail. Full original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; expert/native review pending.

Strict rear with bill/eyes hidden, two folded wings and feet, gray head brown back and two basal/one broad subterminal tail bands. Full original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; expert/native review pending.

Centered ventral, two long broad wings with dark carpal patches and pale barred remiges, pale barred belly, long tail with two basal/one separated broad subterminal bands, one head/bill/two tucked feet. Full original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; expert/native review pending.
